breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two redundant/conflicting lines specifying the time integration method. The ground truth removed the duplicate. The agent successfully resolved this by providing a single, unambiguous instruction for the time integration method: 'Use explicit forward Euler time integration with dt=1e-4 and Nt=10000 steps...'. This correctly removes the conflict.
